description: MOAA catalog: on a strong match, name up to 3 disabled-plugin skills that fit the prompt

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/catalog.py" hook prompt; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit $rc;; esac; done; exit 0
